hookText: POV: You caught the new maid in the quiet corridor, her hands busily braiding light hair, by the window. 🕯️
voiceoverScript:
In our London manor, I sit by my tallow candle in the attic chamber, my fingers weaving through my hair. The cold linen quilt beneath me trembles as I concentrate on the braid. I hear footsteps, and I freeze. The door creaks open, and I look up to see the manor’s new maid, her hair in soft loops. She blushes and quickly turns, leaving me alone once more.
